sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Madhav Roy
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Shyameshwar Dayal
 =====================================================

=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Paroo P.S. Case No. 362 of 2022 registered for the offence under sections 414, 420, 467, 468, 471/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged in the first information report and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The dispute involved between the parties is purely civil in nature.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.67694 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 petitioner, above named, in the event of arrest or surrender within a period of four weeks from today, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of Judicial Magistrate, 1st,
Muzaffarpur in connection with Paroo P.S. Case No. 362 of 2022 subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Arvind Srivastava, J) mcv/-
